notes:
Account summary:
- Product fit: SaaS KB RAG for live customer support chat and async KB search. Primary flow: user query -> recall (ANN) -> cross-encoder rerank -> answer synthesis.
- Scale: target index ~2M canonical docs (~10-12M passages after chunking). Expected steady QPS 400-700 with peaks up to 1,200 qps during enterprise hours.
- Latency targets: median end-to-end <100ms for search path, p95 <250ms. Reranker budget: <80ms added for top-k cross-encoder step.
- Cost sensitivity: voice of customer from CTO: "We need per-query economics to average <= $0.001 (target $0.0008) for recall+rerank+synthesis on hosted infra." High importance for cost per query when scaling.
- Model preferences: open-source embedding model (cheap vector dims), cross-encoder for rerank (prefer Redwood-hosted for latency). Interested in quantized model recommendations from Optimize.
- Architecture notes from SE call: use HNSW index for recall (approx 2M vectors), embed batching + prefetch for high QPS. Plan: hosted API for inference + managed vector index (cloud), fallback to dedicated during spike windows. Want to test KV/prefix caching and continuous batching to reduce per-token cost.
- Security/compliance: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logging, KMS integration, and EU data residency for a portion of customer records. Legal flagged retention controls: need retention_policy=30/90/365 options.
- POC scoping: deliverables = 1) ingest 2M-doc sample + chunking strategy, 2) hosted API perf run at simulated 1,000 qps, measure median/p95 latency, 3) cost-per-query estimate with Optimize suggestions (batching, quantization), 4) quality evaluation on in-house eval set (recall@50, MRR).
- Current baseline (what customer runs today): managed vector DB + separate model endpoint (third-party) -> observed median 180ms, p95 320ms for single-query recall+rerank; cost unknown but >target. Goal: reduce median latency to ~90-110ms and cost to target while preserving or improving MRR.
- Sales/ops notes: AE (Maya) to push POC SOW; SE (Diego) will run synthetic load test in week 1 of POC. Finance asked for 12-month vs 24-month committed pricing scenarios.
- Quotes/phrases captured: CTO Samir: "If we can't get median below 120ms we lose the chat SLAs." Head of Product: "We will trade a little accuracy if it saves 30-40% on cost per query."
- Risks: legal retention hold slows onboarding, SAML integration might add 2-3 weeks, heavy rewrite of chunking pipeline required for older docs.
- Next steps (short): send POC SOW + sample ingestion checklist; schedule load test week (TBD); align on data residency partitioning.
- Reference docs: pricing deck + security QA in Drive (see linked_drive_docs). Fireflies clip from scoping call attached (linked_fireflies). Gmail thread has legal questions (linked_gmail_threads).
- Notes style: shorthand, action-oriented. Expect more granular metrics during POC (p95 breakdown, token-level cost).
